# P37.29 — In-place map activation on dossiers

Ticket: `docs/tickets/453_P37.29__in-place-map-on-dossiers.md` (= R11-K13-VIZ-04 / K6 VIZ-04)
Branch: `r11/P37.29-in-place-map-on-dossiers` ← base `r11/P37.28-dossier-network-figures`
Run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P37.29.md`

## What

The K6 VIZ-04 in-place Figure-1 activation: every drawn-map dossier carries "Explore on the interactive map" — a zero-JS scoped `/map/` link that `<sig-activate>` (the sixth T1 kit element, ADR-243 recording ADR-224's revisit trigger) upgrades to the activation button **only** on an explicit click and **only** on a desktop pointer+width match. The click mounts the K1 map app in embedded mode inside the figure's own reserved box — never a T2 preload, never a fork.

## Deliverables

- `web/src/elements/sig-activate.ts` → `/_kit/sig-activate.js` (t1-module-entries verbatim): the media-query-gated upgrade; post-click `import()` of `/_kit/sig-map-embed.js` + props fetch + css link-inject; mount/unmount; `data-failed`/`data-drawn` watch → honest notice or figure aria-hide; close restores figure + focus.
- The deferred shared-chunk seam: `MapIsland.loadDossierEmbed` lazy-imports `islands/map/dossier-embed` → Vite emits `/_astro/dossier-embed.<hash>.js` sharing every common chunk with `/map/` verbatim; `sigEnhancementKit` emits the stable `/_kit/sig-map-embed.js` re-export shim + `sig-map-embed.css`.
- `sig.dossier-map-embed/1` props document — `lib/map-embed.ts` + `[...path]/map-embed.json.ts`, emitted for exactly the drawn-map dossiers; the `records` payload is the subtree-resolved sites rows (the figure's own scope, SIG-UI-132); `embedded` context (jkey/placeLabel/publicationId/fallbackAt).
- `MapApp` embedded mode: workspace `url:false` (no location reads/writes — V-10), `frame=<jkey>` seed, cooperativeGestures, the §5.4 chrome subset (no view-nav/place-search/myloc; filters row tech·status·source; In-view list + selection below canvas; "Open full map"/"Cite this view" hand-offs; "Close interactive map"); `model.ts` records-path source facet.
- `DossierMapFigure.astro` markup + `epistemic.css`/`islands.css` (reserved-box overlay, embedded layout, print rules — no control or canvas may print; the SVG stays in the DOM).
- Budget leg: `interactions.map-embed` (`kind: activate`, `budget: map`) + `evaluateActivate` — the activated box measured as a T2-map box.
- Tests: `map-embed.test.ts` 6/6, `dossier-activate.spec.ts` 5/5 (unactivated/activated/no-URL-writes/failure/print/axe). `copy-batches/batch-22.md` SA-01/02; ADR-243 + regenerated index; CHANGELOG.
